_comment: File-doubling demo (drill mode -- player army only, no enemy, no auto-win): zoom on the Spearmen block (seed 12345 at ~120,232.5), select it, press N for DUPLICATIO -- alternate files tuck in behind their neighbours, halving the frontage and doubling the depth (a deeper, narrower column). Hold, then press B for EXPLICATIO -- each file splits and the rear half steps out laterally, doubling the frontage and halving the depth (back toward the wide line). Nobody teleports: the soldier bodies ease into the reshaped slots at jog speed. Driven live through the real SelectionManager by tools/demo/DemoInputRecorder.gd; world coordinates; physics ticks (60/s). Re-pinned 2026-11-15 for #1967: the Spearmen block stands against the Infantry beside it, so in the explicatio some of its men are pressed by another regiment. Such a man used to stop following for good and walk on to his place as to a slot; now he stands while pressed and goes on following when the press lifts. The hash stream first differs at tick 240 on seed runs 0 to 4 (cheap tier); its one failing verdict, file_crossing 0.235 against 0.15, is the same on main.
